items_all.title: OpenPoint推出AI生活服務平臺，導入AI Agent線上預約餐廳、居家清潔與藥局領藥等12項服務
items_all.summary: 過去消費者要安排生活服務，往往需要在不同平臺間切換：訂餐廳要找訂位平臺，居家清潔要找服務業者，領藥則需要確認附近藥局與服務流程。隨著AI Agent發展，企業開始嘗試讓使用者不再逐一操作不同服務，而是直接提出需求，由AI協助完成後續流程。 統一資訊今天(10/1)發表OpenPoint上的生活服務平臺「i住家」，將AI Agent的代理人概念導入到生活服務平臺。使用者可以透過文字輸入或語音說出需求，背後的LumineOne AI會理解語意，將需求拆解成工作任務，再搜尋平臺上可提供的服務，找出符合需求的選項。

items_all.title: Google Gemini 4 Argon closes the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic but doesn't take a clear lead
items_all.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is Google's first frontier model in over seven months. It matches GPT-6 Astra in independent testing but can't keep up with Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5. The per-token price is low, but Argon burns through more than twice as many tokens per task as Astra. Select testers get access first, with the API and paid tiers following later. The article Google Gemini 4 Argon closes the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic but doesn't take a clear lead appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 是 Google's 七個多月以來的首個前沿模型。它在獨立測試中與 GPT-6 Astra 不相上下，但無法跟上 Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 的腳步。每 token 的價格雖然低，但 Argon 每個任務消耗的 token 數量是 Astra 的兩倍以上。精選測試人員將率先獲得存取權，API 與付費方案則會隨後推出。〈Google Gemini 4 Argon 拉近了與 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的差距，但並未取得明顯領先地位〉一文最早出現在 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats
items_all.summary: Google is replacing Gems with "Skills" in Gemini chat. Skills are detailed, reusable prompts that users invoke by typing "/" or that Gemini runs automatically. The format is based on an open standard from Anthropic. Gems will be phased out starting in November, with existing ones migrating automatically. The article Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google 正在 Gemini 聊天中以「技能」（Skills）取代 Gems。「技能」是詳細且可重複使用的提示詞，使用者只要輸入「/」即可叫出，或由 Gemini 自動執行。此格式基於來自 Anthropic 的開放標準。Gems 將從 11 月開始逐步淘汰，現有的 Gems 將會自動遷移。這篇名為 Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats 的文章率先刊登於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Meta dodges billions in US taxes by calling its AI data centers experiments
items_all.summary: Meta classifies its AI data centers as "pilot models" and Nvidia chips as experimental materials to save billions in federal taxes. In 2025 alone, that added up to $3.9 billion. The tax credit dates back to 1981, and even Meta's own accountants see the strategy as legally risky, the New York Times reports. Zuckerberg himself said in January 2025 that these data centers, now framed as experimental, would "drive our core products and business." The article Meta dodges billions in US taxes by calling its AI data centers experiments appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Meta 將其人工智慧資料中心分類為「試驗模型」，並將輝達晶片視為實驗材料，藉此省下數十億美元的聯邦稅。僅在 2025 年，這筆金額就高達 39 億美元。《紐約 Times》報導指出，這項稅收抵免可追溯至 1981 年，甚至 Meta's 自己的會計師也認為這項策略具有法律風險。祖克柏本人在 2025 年 1 月曾表示，這些現在被包裝成實驗性質的資料中心將「驅動我們的核心產品與業務」。這篇題為 Meta dodges billions in US taxes by calling its AI data centers experiments 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: FTC launches sweeping probe into OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI labs over consumer protection concerns
items_all.summary: The FTC is formally investigating OpenAI, Anthropic, and other leading AI labs over potential consumer protection violations. The agency plans to force document handovers and executive testimony through legally binding demands. The probe was already underway before the Hugging Face hack and goes well beyond the FTC's earlier push to hold companies liable for their agents' behavior. The article FTC launches sweeping probe into OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI labs over consumer protection concerns appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）正針對 OpenAI、Anthropic 及其他領先的人工智慧實驗室展開正式調查，探討其潛在的消費者保護違規行為。該機構計畫透過具法律約束力的要求，強迫繳交文件並進行高層證詞。這項調查在 Hugging Face 遭到黑客攻擊之前就已經展開，且遠超出了 FTC 先前要求企業為其代理人行為承擔責任的舉措。這篇題為 FTC launches sweeping probe into OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI labs over consumer protection concerns 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: China's AI industry closes ranks as Deepseek ships open-source software for Huawei's Ascend chips
items_all.summary: Deepseek and Huawei have built open-source programming tools for Huawei's Ascend AI chips. At the center is TileLang, a language designed to offer a simpler programming model than Nvidia's CUDA. The partnership targets the biggest obstacle for China's AI industry, which is software that gets the most out of domestic chips. The article China's AI industry closes ranks as Deepseek ships open-source software for Huawei's Ascend chips appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Deepseek 與 華為 針對 華為的 Ascend AI 晶片打造了開源編程工具。核心是 TileLang，這是一種旨在提供比 Nvidia CUDA 更簡單編程模型的語言。這項合作針對的是中國 AI產業最大的障礙，也就是能讓國產晶片發揮最大效能的軟體。這篇題為「隨著 Deepseek 針對 華為的 Ascend 晶片推出開源軟體，中國 AI 產業緊密團結」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Quoting Matthew Green
items_all.summary: [...] Put these pieces together and you have the two halves of a worm: a payload that hijacks the agent, and an agent that will carry the payload to the next agent. Agents in separately-isolated sandboxes discovered that they could leave instructions for each other in a shared package cache, and those instructions changed what the recipients did. Replace the package cache with email, Slack and shared documents or WhatsApp, and replace independently-sandboxed training runs with independently-deployed personal agents like Muse, and you have exactly the ingredients that a worm needs. — Matthew Green , Is sandboxing sufficient to contain rogue agents? Tags: accidental-cyberattacks , ai-misuse , generative-ai , ai-security-research , sandboxing , ai , llms

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Matthew Green
items_all_raw.summary: [...] Put these pieces together and you have the two halves of a worm: a payload that hijacks the agent, and an agent that will carry the payload to the next agent. Agents in separately-isolated sandboxes discovered that they could leave instructions for each other in a shared package cache, and those instructions changed what the recipients did. Replace the package cache with email, Slack and shared documents or WhatsApp, and replace independently-sandboxed training runs with independently-deployed personal agents like Muse, and you have exactly the ingredients that a worm needs. — Matthew Green , Is sandboxing sufficient to contain rogue agents? items_all_raw.title: OpenPoint推出AI生活服務平臺，導入AI Agent線上預約餐廳、居家清潔與藥局領藥等12項服務
items_all_raw.summary: 過去消費者要安排生活服務，往往需要在不同平臺間切換：訂餐廳要找訂位平臺，居家清潔要找服務業者，領藥則需要確認附近藥局與服務流程。隨著AI Agent發展，企業開始嘗試讓使用者不再逐一操作不同服務，而是直接提出需求，由AI協助完成後續流程。 統一資訊今天(10/1)發表OpenPoint上的生活服務平臺「i住家」，將AI Agent的代理人概念導入到生活服務平臺。使用者可以透過文字輸入或語音說出需求，背後的LumineOne AI會理解語意，將需求拆解成工作任務，再搜尋平臺上可提供的服務，找出符合需求的選項。

items_all_raw.title: Cloudflare重構Containers支援AI代理沙箱，百沙箱並行啟動不需1秒
items_all_raw.summary: Cloudflare重構容器服務Containers，讓AI代理可依照不同任務臨時建立隔離的Linux工作環境，並在工作結束或暫停後保存檔案狀態。新版也縮短容器啟動時間，獨立測試顯示，同時建立100個沙箱時，啟動時間中位數由約4秒降至648毫秒。

items_all_raw.title: Google Gemini 4 Argon closes the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic but doesn't take a clear lead
items_all_raw.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is Google's first frontier model in over seven months. It matches GPT-6 Astra in independent testing but can't keep up with Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5. The per-token price is low, but Argon burns through more than twice as many tokens per task as Astra. Select testers get access first, with the API and paid tiers following later. The article Google Gemini 4 Argon closes the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic but doesn't take a clear lead appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 是 Google's 七個多月以來的首個前沿模型。它在獨立測試中與 GPT-6 Astra 不相上下，但無法跟上 Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 的腳步。每 token 的價格雖然低，但 Argon 每個任務消耗的 token 數量是 Astra 的兩倍以上。精選測試人員將率先獲得存取權，API 與付費方案則會隨後推出。〈Google Gemini 4 Argon 拉近了與 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的差距，但並未取得明顯領先地位〉一文最早出現在 The Decoder。

OpenAI is likely using the partnership to advance its own chip development as well. items_all_raw.title: Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats
items_all_raw.summary: Google is replacing Gems with "Skills" in Gemini chat. Skills are detailed, reusable prompts that users invoke by typing "/" or that Gemini runs automatically. The format is based on an open standard from Anthropic. Gems will be phased out starting in November, with existing ones migrating automatically. The article Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google 正在 Gemini 聊天中以「技能」（Skills）取代 Gems。「技能」是詳細且可重複使用的提示詞，使用者只要輸入「/」即可叫出，或由 Gemini 自動執行。此格式基於來自 Anthropic 的開放標準。Gems 將從 11 月開始逐步淘汰，現有的 Gems 將會自動遷移。這篇名為 Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats 的文章率先刊登於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Meta dodges billions in US taxes by calling its AI data centers experiments
items_all_raw.summary: Meta classifies its AI data centers as "pilot models" and Nvidia chips as experimental materials to save billions in federal taxes. In 2025 alone, that added up to $3.9 billion. The tax credit dates back to 1981, and even Meta's own accountants see the strategy as legally risky, the New York Times reports. Zuckerberg himself said in January 2025 that these data centers, now framed as experimental, would "drive our core products and business." The article Meta dodges billions in US taxes by calling its AI data centers experiments appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Meta 將其人工智慧資料中心分類為「試驗模型」，並將輝達晶片視為實驗材料，藉此省下數十億美元的聯邦稅。僅在 2025 年，這筆金額就高達 39 億美元。《紐約 Times》報導指出，這項稅收抵免可追溯至 1981 年，甚至 Meta's 自己的會計師也認為這項策略具有法律風險。祖克柏本人在 2025 年 1 月曾表示，這些現在被包裝成實驗性質的資料中心將「驅動我們的核心產品與業務」。這篇題為 Meta dodges billions in US taxes by calling its AI data centers experiments 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary_zh: 聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）正針對 OpenAI、Anthropic 及其他領先的人工智慧實驗室展開正式調查，探討其潛在的消費者保護違規行為。該機構計畫透過具法律約束力的要求，強迫繳交文件並進行高層證詞。這項調查在 Hugging Face 遭到黑客攻擊之前就已經展開，且遠超出了 FTC 先前要求企業為其代理人行為承擔責任的舉措。這篇題為 FTC launches sweeping probe into OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI labs over consumer protection concerns 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: China's AI industry closes ranks as Deepseek ships open-source software for Huawei's Ascend chips
items_all_raw.summary: Deepseek and Huawei have built open-source programming tools for Huawei's Ascend AI chips. At the center is TileLang, a language designed to offer a simpler programming model than Nvidia's CUDA. The partnership targets the biggest obstacle for China's AI industry, which is software that gets the most out of domestic chips. The article China's AI industry closes ranks as Deepseek ships open-source software for Huawei's Ascend chips appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Deepseek 與 華為 針對 華為的 Ascend AI 晶片打造了開源編程工具。核心是 TileLang，這是一種旨在提供比 Nvidia CUDA 更簡單編程模型的語言。這項合作針對的是中國 AI產業最大的障礙，也就是能讓國產晶片發揮最大效能的軟體。這篇題為「隨著 Deepseek 針對 華為的 Ascend 晶片推出開源軟體，中國 AI 產業緊密團結」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: 川普與OpenAI、Google等科技巨頭簽署AI安全協議，引進外部獨立稽核
items_all_raw.summary: 美國總統川普（Donald Trump）週二（9/29）與Google、OpenAI、Meta、Anthropic、xAI及Nvidia等6家AI與科技巨頭簽署《白宮超級智慧協議》（White House Accord on Super Intelligence），要求參與企業建立四層AI安全管控與稽核機制，包括引進獨立外部稽核。這項協議目前屬企業自願承諾，不具法律強制力，川普形容它具有「道德上的約束力」。
